description.value:
You have learned to channel a single, simple use of the Force, taught to you outside any formal tradition. Choose one at-will Force power of 1st level or lower from the shared Force powers list; you can cast it once, without expending a power point or requiring a Force-casting class feature, using Wisdom or Charisma (your choice, fixed when you take this feat) as your Force-casting ability.

You regain the ability to cast the chosen power when you finish a long rest.
